title: PH urges global partners to build science-based high seas protection

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines must work with other countries to protect its own coastal waters, which are linked to the open ocean, Environment Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna said in a statement on Tuesday. With this in mind, he said, the country looks forward to forging a strategic alignment with key stakeholders so that when the Conference of the Parties (COP) meets in January 2027, it can immediately begin laying the foundations for “scientifically robust, inclusive, and effective protection of biodiversity in the high seas.” “For us, the protection of biodiversity within and beyond national jurisdiction cannot be considered in isolation.
